posts.author: Cenewulf_TTV
posts.body:
Star Wars reference aside, what's up y'all. My name is Cenewulf [Ken Nah Wulf]. I am a musician, martial artist, IT technician, and competitive fencer who also loves to make content around gaming, music, and martial arts over on Twitch. TikTok and youtube. Back in the day, I used to play around with RPG Maker VX Ace ages ago after a friend let me try out XP at his house even further back. I picked up MV around 2018, and evidently I had put 60 hours into...something, but I don't have that PC anymore so I am starting from scratch on both fronts.
Right now, I am working on a game I am currently calling Heroes without Borders. The idea is that it's a linear RPG that slowly turns into a mystery dungeon game as the main story beats progress. I have Aerosys' random dungeon plugin, and I snagged Yanfly's bundle because they are just such great plugins, but I'm running into issues getting the random dungeon scripts to work. I'm sure I'll figure it out eventually, though. The main reason I'm making the game, besides the fact that we don't see very many mystery dungeon games these days, is also a way to get my music out there.
I've been playing guitar for about 20 years and Bass for 5. Music in video games to me are extremely important because it can help not just set the scene but also invoke emotion. Like the last 5 minutes of fighting The Boss in MGS3, and you hear that "what a thrill..." while she's swiss cheesing you with the patriot. So you can imagine my excitement when I converted one of my originals to an .ogg format and got to hear my work in something else I'm making.
Anyways, thanks for reading. Hoping to make some new friends in this space.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum!
It sounds like you already have a great start for what you want to do.
What style(s) of martial art(s) did/do you practice? I have studied many different styles over the years, but I eventually taught Chinese Kenpo, Filipino Modern Arnis, and BJJ in my own school for 4-5 years.
Any way, good luck on your projects and thanks for introducing yourself!

posts.author: Cenewulf_TTV
posts.body: That's very cool! I studied Shugy-ryu (Okinawan Karate and Aikido mixed together), Capoeria and I also do competitive armored stuff like HEMA and TSL.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
That's awesome!
My very first karate class back in the early 80's was something called Ketsugo Karate which was supposedly a version of Okinawan Kenpo. I also studied Shaolin Kenpo, Tae Kwon Do, Wing Chun, and Ninjutsu.
I hope you are able to stay involved. I haven't actively worked out in over a decade and it would take a bit to get this old zombie body back into the swing of things.

posts.author: Cenewulf_TTV
posts.body: Yeah I still do HEMA and TSL but I haven't been fortunate enough to be in a position to learn a new hand based style formally.
